title: Service-Member Upgrade Credit
content:
**Q. What is the service-member upgrade credit?**
A. A credit taken off the upgrade fee when a membership of Northgate Memberships moves to its Plus tier, recognising membership fees paid at the Heroes Club annual fee. Membership fees charged at the Heroes Club annual fee of 45.50 dollars in the 36 months before the upgrade date earn a service-member upgrade credit of 14.50 dollars when there are three or more of them, 7.25 dollars when there are one or two, and nothing when there are none.

**Q. Which fees count?**
A. Membership fee charges on the membership's ledger of exactly 45.50 dollars, whose charge date lies fewer than 36 whole months before the upgrade date.

**Q. What are the bands?**

| Fees charged at 45.50 dollars in the 36 months before the upgrade date | Service-member upgrade credit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 14.50 |
| 1 or 2 | 7.25 |
| none | none |

**Q. Hypothetical: a membership held at Heroes Club with renewal fees of 45.50 charged in each of the last three years, the earliest 30 whole months before the upgrade date?**
A. Three fees within the 36 months — 14.50 dollars.

**Q. Hypothetical: the earliest of those three fees was charged 36 whole months before the upgrade date?**
A. That fee falls outside the 36 months; two remain — 7.25 dollars.

**Q. Hypothetical: a Club membership with no fee ever charged at 45.50?**
A. None counts — no credit.
